review_evidence: Reviewed all 231 primary Lean files by unit-wide declaration/statement scan and source role; the repository is a large formal development of quantum algorithms, primitives, linear algebra/number theory and explicit quantum/classical resource-cost models.

169 primary files contain theorem/lemma/example/axiom statement forms and 181 contain ordinary declaration forms; files with names such as HadamardTest/SwapTest are mathematical quantum primitives rather than disposable test runners. No source-local hard exclusion was established.
summary: Reviewed Lean-QuantumAlg and retain all 231 primary files; the apparent test terminology belongs to substantive quantum-algorithm formalization and no safe repository-local exclusion was found.
